brief:
Palestine News Network has launched "Al-Makshouf," a new programme designed to strengthen independent journalism and public accountability in Palestinian society, the outlet reported. The initiative aims to develop professional media content that amplifies community voices while addressing gaps in current coverage.

The programme is part of PNN's broader efforts to reinforce independent media's role in holding institutions accountable and engaging Palestinian communities in journalistic processes.

title: Palestine News Network launches accountability program for independent journalism
